stem.text: Determine whether the series \( \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n \), where \( a_n = \frac{2^{n}}{n!} \), converges or diverges. Name a test whose conditions the series meets and state the verdict it gives.

answer_key.label: The series converges by the ratio test, because \( \lim_{n\to\infty} \left|\frac{a_{n+1}}{a_n}\right| = 0 < 1 \).

worked_solution.text: The general term \( \frac{2^{n}}{n!} \) contains a factorial, so the ratio test fits.
worked_solution.rule_named: match the form to a test

The series diverges by the nth term test, because \( \lim_{n\to\infty} a_n = \infty \).
options.derivation: the limit of the terms taken as infinite because the numerator grows without bound
